simple.meaning: שָׂרַר (sârar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to have (transitively, exercise ; reflexively, get ) dominion.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in Numbers, Esther, Proverbs, Isaiah, Hosea, beginning at Numbers 16:13. The surrounding contexts include righteousness, kingship, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂרַר (H8323) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׂרַר (sârar) / H8323 is traced through Numbers 16:13, Esther 1:22, Proverbs 8:16, Isaiah 32:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.
